description: Re-check ownership for one site owned by this API key using its verification material: DNS TXT record, /.well-known file or homepage meta tag. The verdict is persisted as verified/failed with a reason; a failed check still returns a structured result so you can report the reason. Google-bound sites skip manual verification. Requires the sites:write scope. Writes need confirm:true plus a unique idempotencyKey; without confirm:true it returns a dry-run preview and fetches nothing. Reusing the same idempotencyKey within 24h returns the first result.

siteId.description: Site id from add_site or list_sites

name: verify_site
title: Verify site ownership
